_comment: Hand-written specs of frap's own operators (namespace `frap`, OPERATORS.md §A `frap.*`), in the dump schema of spec/blender-5.2/ops/<ns>.json. There is no Blender dump: `poll` is null (OperatorSpec.poll_matrix = None, RFC 0001 F-OP-3). Each later frap.* operator is added here by the WP that implements it.

operators.label: Describe
operators.description: Describe an operator (op:<idname>), a struct (struct:<Struct>), a property (<Struct>.<prop>) or another --describe target as its manifest fragment, answered in result.describe (frap extension)

props.name: Target
props.description: What to describe: op:<idname> (or mesh.bevel), struct:<Struct> (or Object), <Struct>.<prop>, errors, protocol, manifest
